ticker_news.title: Is AMD Stock a Buy Now?
ticker_news.description: AMD has underperformed the semiconductor index in the past year, partly due to its small share in the AI chip market. However, the company has growth opportunities in the PC and server CPU markets, and its valuation appears attractive based on its projected earnings growth.
ticker_news.author: Harsh Chauhan

SPY.title: US Stocks Set For Gains Ahead Of Q1 GDP, Apple Earnings: Expert Says 'Higher January' Bodes Well For The Rest Of The Year
SPY.description: US stock futures are up ahead of Q1 GDP data and Apple's earnings report. An expert says a strong January performance bodes well for the rest of the year. Several companies are set to report earnings, including Apple, UPS, and Meta.
SPY.author: Rishabh Mishra
